verses.english: “Mendicants, these four things oppose the true teaching.

verses.pali: Kodhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, makkhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, lābhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, sakkāragarutā na saddhammagarutā.
verses.english: Valuing anger, denigration, material things, and honor rather than the true teaching.
These are the four things that oppose the true teaching.
These four things are the true teaching.

verses.pali: Saddhammagarutā na kodhagarutā, saddhammagarutā na makkhagarutā, saddhammagarutā na lābhagarutā, saddhammagarutā na sakkāragarutā.
verses.english: Valuing the true teaching rather than anger, denigration, material things, and honor.
These are the four things that are the true teaching.
A mendicant who values anger and denigration,
doesn’t grow in the true teaching,
like a rotten seed in a good field.
But those who value the true teaching,
who have lived it, and are living it now,
these do grow in the teaching,
